profile.title: Cynefin framework
profile.canonical_definition: Decision-support framework for discerning context and choosing approaches on the basis of bounded applicability, distinguishing ordered, complex, chaotic and aporetic conditions and their dynamics.
profile.summary: Cynefin is a context-discrimination and decision-support framework. It asks which causal conditions and constraints are present, which approaches are applicable, and when a shift in context requires a change of method.
profile.why_it_matters: It counters the habit of treating one method as universally valid. Its domains are most useful when treated dynamically and provisionally rather than as labels attached permanently to problems.
key_distinctions: clear and complicated order vs complexity vs chaos
historical_lineage: A Leader's Framework for Decision Making
common_misreadings: Cynefin sorts every issue once and for all
complex is a synonym for difficult
the framework itself supplies a complete intervention
open_checks: compare with other contingency and problem-structuring frameworks
